en.title: Counter Differences
en.description:
For each position i of the array, check every j<i from left to right: if the left value is greater than the current value, subtract the absolute difference; if the left value is less than or equal to the current value, add the absolute difference. Output the accumulated counter for each position.

See the statement/review record for the problem source and the basis of the rules; limits marked in the input ranges are supplements added by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n integers arr[i]. The original gives no value constraints; this site adds 1≤n≤100000, −10^9≤arr[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output n integers, the counter of each position in the original array order.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the problem rules; see the companion notes for the full approach, the correctness argument and the complexity.
hints: For any left element a[j], its contribution is exactly a[i]−a[j] (0 when they are equal). Therefore counter[i]=i×a[i]−(prefix sum).
